sloka: विवेश अंगदो भूमौ रुदन् दर्भेषु दुर्मनाः ।तस्य संविशतः तत्र रुदन्तो वानर ऋषभाः ॥४-५५-१७॥
transliteration: viveśa aṁgado bhūmau rudan darbheṣu durmanāḥ ।tasya saṁviśataḥ tatra rudanto vānara ṛṣabhāḥ ॥4-55-17॥

translations.english: Seeing him lie down the bulls among the monkeys became sad and shed hot tears from their eyes.
